title: Jurisdiction
description: A governed territory: a country, region, municipality, or special-purpose area. A Jurisdiction is a Place. It has no employees, departments, or legislation - those belong to the Organization that governs it, which points here with areaServed. Keeping these two apart is the central rule of this profile.

@type.description: Use the most specific schema.org type that applies.

alternateName.description: Endonyms, historical names, and the local-language term for the tier (e.g. 'Comune di Bologna').

identifier.description: At least one. A Wikidata QID is strongly recommended as the cross-border join key.

governmentLevel.description: termCode from the GovernmentLevel code list.

containedInPlace.description: The next jurisdiction up. Chaining these yields the full territorial hierarchy without any country-specific nesting rules.

population.description: A QuantitativeValue, so the count keeps its observation date and source.

jurisdictionOf.description: Government organizations governing this area. Convenience inverse of Organization.areaServed.
